# Mahabub

> Business-minded virtual assistant, social media manager and creative partner based in Bangladesh, available for remote work. Handles the full chain: planning, content, video editing, graphic design, websites and outreach. Learns new tools quickly and communicates clearly in English and Bangla.

## Services
- Virtual assistance: inbox, scheduling, research, data entry, Excel
- Social media management: content planning, posting, community replies
- Video editing: short-form and long-form (CapCut, Kdenlive)
- Graphic design: thumbnails, typography, social graphics (Canva)
- Websites: building and maintaining simple, fast sites
- Business development: outreach and lead research

## Background
- Business and finance student (BBA), Government Titumir College
- About a year of paid teaching, with self-made study materials and video lectures
- Building ICTLab, an edtech platform for HSC students
- Publishes YouTube content
